Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

7 : 21 :: 14 : 42 :: 18 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

First number × 3 = Second number

 
• 7 : 21 → 7 × 3 = 21

and

 
• 14 : 42 → 14 × 3 = 42

Similarly,

 
• 18 : ? → 18 × 3 = 54

Hence, the correct answer is** "54".**

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

36 * 12 * 6 * 12 * 3 = 63
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

Option 1) : ×, ÷, -, +

Given equation : 36 * 12 * 6 * 12 * 3 = 63

After inserting the mathematical operators in given equation the equation is as follows : 36 × 12 ÷ 6 - 12 + 3 = 63

⇒ 36 × __**12 ÷ 6**__ - 12 + 3 = 63

⇒ __**36 × 2**__ - 12 + 3 = 63

⇒ __**72**__ - 12 __**+ 3**__ = 63

⇒ __**75 - 12**__ = 63

⇒ **63 = 63**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : ÷, -, +, × 

Given equation : 36 * 12 * 6 * 12 * 3 = 63

After inserting the mathematical operators in given equation the equation is as follows : 36 ÷ 12 - 6 + 12 × 3 = 63

⇒ __**36 ÷ 12**__ - 6 + 12 × 3 = 63

⇒ 3 - 6 + __**12 × 3**__ = 63

⇒ __**3**__ - 6 __**+ 36**__ = 63

⇒ __**39 - 6**__ = 63

⇒ 33 ≠ 63

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ÷, +, -, × 

Given equation : 36 * 12 * 6 * 12 * 3 = 63

After inserting the mathematical operators in given equation the equation is as follows : 36 ÷ 12 + 6 - 12 × 3 = 63

⇒ __**36 ÷ 12**__ + 6 - 12 × 3 = 63

⇒ 3 + 6 - __**12 × 3**__ = 63

⇒ __**3 + 6**__ - 36 = 63

⇒ __**9 - 36**__ = 63

⇒ 27 ≠ 63

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : +, ÷, ×, -

Given equation : 36 * 12 * 6 * 12 * 3 = 63

After inserting the mathematical operators in given equation the equation is as follows : 36 + 12 ÷ 6 × 12 - 3 = 63

⇒ 36 + __**12 ÷ 6**__ × 12 - 3 = 63

⇒ 36 + __**2 × 12**__ - 3 = 63

⇒ __**36 + 24**__ - 3 = 63

⇒ __**60 - 3**__ = 63

⇒ 57 ≠ 63

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"×, ÷, -, +".**

questions.question:
A % B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

A = B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A $ B means ‘A is the father of B’

X % Y = Z % W $ V, then how is Z related to V?
questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599c31a3b6c5ca06ce1787b908a152975e0540fada6e60ee63a4282f38f5a661.png] 

A % B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

A = B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A $ B means ‘A is the father of B’

 
 

 Symbol

The given expression is :-

'X % Y = Z % W $ V' → X is daughter of Y, Y is sister of Z, Z is daughter of W, W is father of V.

questions.question:
Select the set In which the numbers are related In the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers Into Its constituent digits. E.g. 13 — Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(47, 108, 169)

(22, 83, 144)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(2nd number × 2) - 1st number = 3rd number**.

(47, 108, 169)

⇒ (108 × 2) - 47

⇒ 216 - 47 = 169.

(22, 83, 144) 

⇒ (83 × 2) - 22

⇒ 166 - 22 = 144.

Similarly, **(51, 112, 173) **

**⇒ (112 × 2) - 51**

**⇒ 224 - 51 = 173.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

The logic followed here is :-

Second number = First number + 61 

Third number = First number + 122

 
• (47, 108, 169) → (47, 47 + 61, 47 + 122)

and

 
• (22, 83, 144) → (22, 22 + 61, 22 + 122)

Similarly,

 
• **(51, 112, 173) → (51, 51 + 61, 51 + 122)**

Hence, the correct answer is** "(51, 112, 173)".**
